attempts.text:
**The window opens on a long spine.** Columns 0 to 16, `osmY` to `lgoD`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 17% of calls. The model names 18 to 100% of them, fewest at column 9, `yjjQ`, 18%.

**A short fork follows the spine**, columns 17 and 18, `lgoR` and `lgoT`, shell, carried by 86 and 73%. Then a branch of 11 shell families runs through columns 20 to 30, [[4-hydroxyphenylacetate catabolism]], carried by 28 to 33%. The `fim` genes, columns 46 to 54, are [[type 1 fimbria]], carried by 59 to 74%.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 89 against 81%, and hesitates less there, 0.40 against 0.86 bits. It hesitates most at column 41, `uxuR`, a fork column, 1.31 bits.

**The window ends in variable and fork columns.** Columns 57 to 71, `YthB` to `lptF`, are carried by 4 to 47%. The last column is `ahr`, in 31% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 83% of genes**, 0.76 bits on average, perplexity 2.2 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.21 against 0.37 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 94%.

label: osmY
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the osmY window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor osmY, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,744 to 3,823 from dnaA. Read in 537 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying osmY once); 42,960 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 83% of genes, 0.76 bits on average (perplexity 2.2 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 20,013 calls, named 95%, 0.21 bits; shell 21,761 calls, named 76%, 1.14 bits; cloud 1,186 calls, named 15%, 3.10 bits. Outside an RGP 23,090 calls, named 94%, 0.37 bits; inside an RGP 19,870 calls, named 71%, 1.21 bits. Columns: 18 spine, 35 fork, 27 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.21 against 0.37 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 94%); 19,870 of the 42,960 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 41 (uxuR, a fork column) 1.31 bits, RGP 36%; column 59 ("DUF957 domain-containing protein", a variable column) 1.25 bits, RGP 56%; column 40 ("hypothetical protein", a fork column) 1.23 bits, RGP 37%. The 46 columns (columns 17-21, 23-30, 46 and 48-79) where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.88 bits on average; the other 34 columns: named 88%, 0.59 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 18 spine columns: named 89%, 0.40 bits on average; the 62 fork and variable columns: named 81%, 0.86 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 41, is a fork column.
[P] PLASTICITY (the stretches below, by their mean over columns): the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 19 (spine), RGP 56%; the least: columns 0-16 (spine), RGP 0-17%.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-16 (17 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-17%. Genes: osmY, prfC, yjjG "pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase", rimI, holD, rsmC, yjjZ "DUF1435 domain-containing protein", fhuF, bglJ, yjjQ "helix-turn-helix domain-containing…", yjjP "threonine/serine ThrE exporter fami…", yjjB "threonine/serine exporter", dnaT "primosomal protein DnaT", dnaC, yjjA "DUF2501 domain-containing protein Y…", opgB, lgoD "L-galactonate oxidoreductase". named 18-100% (mean 90%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 9 (yjjQ), named 18%, 0.93 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 17-18 (2 columns) fork and variable columns: share 73-86%, all S, RGP 55-56%. named 87-88% (mean 87%), fewest named at column 17, named 87%; most hesitant at column 18, 0.95 bits.
